messages:
sarah: Quick ask from Acme POC — procurement wants SOC 2 Type II, ISO scope doc, and a pen-test attestation by next Wed. Any blockers?

diego: We can pull SOC2 and ISO scope. Pen-test attestation usually a signed letter or exec summary. Who owns signing?

kaya: We don't issue new detailed vuln reports for POCs. We can provide a redacted pen-test exec summary + a short attestation template from Legal. If they need raw vuln data we need a legal NDAs + justification. :eyes:

oliver: I can sign an attestation that summarizes scope and confirms we performed a 3rd-party test with no outstanding critical confidentiality findings. We won't disclose exploit details. Need the exact customer name + PO# to include in the letter.

sarah: Procurement asked for an "evidence bundle" with filenames and a one-line description each. Can we have that by Tue EOD?

diego: I'll assemble: `SOC2-Report-TypeII-2024.pdf` (full report), `ISO27001-scope-2023.pdf` (scope & cert), `pen-test-exec-summary-redacted.pdf` (3rd-party exec summary), `infra-network-diagram.png` (in-scope infra). Need perms to upload to a pre-signed S3 for sharing.

kaya: Add a short note listing in-scope services (hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private). If customer will push prod-like data, recommend Private or clear redaction steps.

mia: @sarah on pricing — we have a POC credit: 40% off hosted inference for first 90 days up to $5k usage. To apply it we need an SOW or internal pricing approval ticket.

sarah: @mia can you confirm the wording we should put in the SOW so procurement signs?

mia: I will draft SOW clause: "POC discount: 40% discount on hosted usage for 90 days, max credit $5,000; standard T&Cs apply." I can have a draft by Tue morning.

oliver: Also related: we should add a short data-handling clause: no retention beyond POC timeframe, hashed tokens allowed, and breach notification timeline. I'll include that in the attestation.

diego: Note on provisioning — if they want a Private VPC POC for isolation, infra lead says ~72 business hours to spin up + firewall rules. If they accept hosted with strict redaction, faster.

sarah: Plan: Diego assembles bundle by Mon EOD, Oliver prepares signed attestation Tue, Mia finalizes SOW clause Tue, ops-bot uploads and shares pre-signed link Wed AM to procurement. Everyone ok with that cadence?

kaya: That works. I'll also add a one-paragraph threat-model statement to the bundle.

oliver: Fine with timeline; I'll need the customer exact legal entity to sign.

mia: I'll DM the SOW draft to @sarah once ready.

ops-bot: Document bundle workspace created: `s3://redwood-pocs/acme-1987654321/` (internal access only). I will post the pre-signed link after legal approves the attestation.

sarah: Thanks — I'll chase procurement for PO# and share here. If they push the deadline, we'll escalate. :thumbsup:

diego: FYI I'll need a quick infra ticket for the pre-signed S3 path, tagging `#deploy` and `#security`.

sarah: Great — tagging this as action items. Will update when I have PO#. :white_check_mark:
